Name: Angry Barry
Overview:
Barry is a man from Hawaii, who was once an ordinary young man. But one day, he was struck by a strange meteor, and now whenever he's angered, he turns into the super-strong Angry Barry, who wants to rule the earth. This usually wears off before long, but one day Barry found a fingernail in his hot dog, which made him so angry that he turned into Angry Barry permanently. Now, he's off to beat the unwashed masses and win their votes in a quest for world domination.

Angry Barry is a side-scrolling beat-'em-up political parody. Barry, the "President of Butt Kicking", must make his way through each stage, beating up conservatives, FBI agents, old ladies, and anyone else who gets in his way. Beating up enemies wins him votes, and he must collect a set amount of votes in order to complete the stage. He can punch and kick, comboing them together for additional damage, as well as jump between multiple planes, and even charge up a super-powerful "hope punch". One or two players can play simultaneously, and there are two difficulty settings.
